film_identity.narrative_stance: Human-scale emotions framed against forces larger than the individual
film_identity.emotional_thesis: Inner calm and resilience persist even when the external world is unstable
film_identity.pacing_philosophy: Deliberate and unhurried, allowing emotion to emerge through silence and duration

world.setting_principle: Isolated human habitats embedded within dominant natural environments
world.environmental_hierarchy: Nature always outweighs human presence in scale and power
world.temporal_feel: Timeless or pre-digital, avoiding contemporary markers

world_rules.Human_Spaces: Protective, enclosed, and built for endurance rather than comfort

world.atmospheric_logic: Weather and environment are narrative forces, not background decoration

visual_style.animation_philosophy: Stylized realism that prioritizes emotional readability over physical accuracy
visual_style.texture_strategy: Tactile, handcrafted surfaces with visible material history

rendering_approach.Overall: Physically grounded lighting and materials with artistic restraint
rendering_approach.Detail_Level: High enough to feel lived-in, never hyperreal

color_logic.Contrast_Use: Color temperature contrast used as emotional and narrative separation

characters.design_philosophy: Characters are expressive but grounded, avoiding caricature
characters.proportion_rules: Slightly idealized proportions to enhance clarity of emotion
characters.facial_language: Eyes and subtle facial shifts carry primary emotional information
characters.performance_priority: Internal emotion expressed through micro-movements rather than overt action

cinematography.lens_philosophy: Naturalistic focal lengths that preserve spatial honesty
cinematography.movement_rules: Camera moves only when emotionally justified
cinematography.spatial_composition: Human figures consistently contextualized within their environment
cinematography.visual_metaphor: Frames often juxtapose fragile interiors against overwhelming exteriors

lighting_rules.lighting_philosophy: Always motivated by believable sources within the world
lighting_rules.shadow_language: Soft-edged shadows indoors, chaotic and high-contrast outdoors

atmospheric_effects.Rain: Used to add density, motion, and emotional pressure
atmospheric_effects.Mist: Creates depth, scale, and emotional distance
atmospheric_effects.Lightning: Momentary truth-revealing flashes rather than spectacle

framing_philosophy.negative_space_strategy: Used to communicate isolation, waiting, and emotional pause
framing_philosophy.compositional_discipline: Balanced but flexible, prioritizing emotional clarity over strict rules
framing_philosophy.staging_convention: Foreground elements frequently frame subjects to enhance intimacy and depth
